claim2.description: Claim 2: is the DQN's predicted I-value a better uncertainty measure than traditional UQ methods? A within-run comparison -- every method scores the SAME record table, so the model and its predictions are identical and only the score differs. Every cell uses the i-value traversal, because without a DQN there is no u_ivalue column at all. Each cell adds the methods its head or sampling setting makes available; val records are recorded throughout so temperature scaling can be fitted off-test.
